category: 50 LPA AI Systems Engineer High-Frequency Interview Bank

questions.question: How do you architect an enterprise AI agent system that guarantees 99.9% uptime when OpenAI or Claude APIs throw 429 Rate Limit or 503 Service Unavailable errors?
expectedKeyPoints: Token bucket / Leaky bucket rate limiting at the gateway level
Exponential backoff with randomized jitter
Multi-model fallback routing (e.g. Primary: Claude 3.5 Sonnet -> Fallback: GPT-4o -> Local/Groq Llama 3.3 70B)
Circuit breaker pattern (pybreaker / resilience4j style)
Idempotency keys in message queues (RabbitMQ/Redis Streams) to avoid duplicate agent actions

questions.question: Explain how you stream token-by-token LLM output from a background Python agent to a Next.js/browser frontend with sub-100ms time-to-first-token (TTFT).
expectedKeyPoints: FastAPI StreamingResponse with Server-Sent Events (SSE / `text/event-stream`)
Async generators yielding chunk deltas instead of waiting for complete completion
Speculative decoding / Prompt caching at the LLM provider level
Bypassing heavy middleware buffers that block chunk flushing

questions.topic: Agent Infinite Loops & Hallucinated Tool Calls
questions.question: What mechanisms do you implement to prevent an autonomous multi-agent system from getting trapped in an expensive infinite tool-calling loop or hallucinating non-existent tools?
expectedKeyPoints: Hard max_iterations cutoff & token budget limits per run
State graph cycle detection (detecting identical state hashes across consecutive turns)
Strict Pydantic JSON schema validation on tool arguments with structured outputs
Fallback human-in-the-loop escalation interrupts when confidence drops below threshold

questions.question: Why does simple cosine similarity on OpenAI embeddings fail in production, and how do you build a production-grade Hybrid RAG retrieval pipeline?
expectedKeyPoints: Dense vectors capture semantics but miss exact keyword identifiers, part numbers, and acronyms
Hybrid Search: Combining Dense (HNSW / vector index) + Sparse (BM25 lexical search)
Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) to merge ranked lists from both methods
Cross-Encoder Re-ranking on top 20 candidates down to top 5
Contextual chunking (prepending document title and summary to chunks before embedding)

questions.question: How do you evaluate and guarantee that a prompt or agent update doesn't silently break existing capabilities (Regression)?
expectedKeyPoints: Golden test dataset with known ground-truth inputs and expected outputs
Ragas / DeepEval metrics: Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, Context Recall, Context Precision
Automated CI/CD GitHub Actions workflow that runs eval suite on pull requests
LLM-as-a-Judge with calibrated scoring rubrics and few-shot calibration examples
